primary.name: rtx 3080
primary.def: an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 or RTX 3080 Ti graphics card (carte graphique, Grafikkarte, scheda video, tarjeta gráfica), standalone — the model must be 3080 or 3080 Ti, any brand's cooler
